scope: Publish current-source copied B1024 profiling and valid B2048 live throughput;no optimum claim.
limitations: One32-condition bank is copied across all environments,including delays. Existing componentwise footprint/FP64/Q10/s8/error budgets are unchanged. B1024 profile and B2048 live run on distinct allocated GPUs and are not a matched batch-speedup comparison. Profiling replays an actual contact snapshot and includes graph/stage wall timing;it is not live throughput. B2048 reports every environment/reset/failure counter for three complete repetitions. No new independent per-stepCPUoracle,diverse seeds,policy acceptance,maximum throughput or plateau is claimed. Full raw JSON/logs are retained losslessly with explicit gzip encoding where large;original and stored hashes are separate.
